after.name: DD-0001: No custom code development

data.problem: The scope of the Salesforce implementation needs to be defined to ensure project delivery within the 10-week timeline and fixed-fee budget, preventing uncontrolled growth of complexity.
data.recommendation: Use declarative Salesforce configuration only; custom Apex triggers, Lightning Web Components, and Visualforce pages are strictly out of scope.
data.rationale: By relying on standard platform capabilities, the project can maintain a predictable delivery schedule and stay within the agreed fixed-fee structure.
data.implementation_impact: All business requirements must be satisfied using standard objects, flows, and out-of-the-box Salesforce features.

after.body:
## Consequences

after.name: SOW-0001: Statement of Work (SOW): Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud Implementation v1.0

data.scope_summary: Apex Cloud Partners LLC will implement Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud for Vanguard Logistics & Supply Co. to unify their CRM platform. The scope includes core platform configuration, sales and service cloud modules, automation flows, data migration, and training/hypercare services.
out_of_scope: Custom Apex triggers, Lightning Web Components (LWCs), or Visualforce pages
Bidirectional ERP or WMS (Warehouse Management System) API integrations
Salesforce CPQ, Marketing Cloud, or Experience Cloud portals
Historical data migration older than 12 months for Cases or Closed/Lost Opportunities
acceptance_criteria: Client will provide clean, deduplicated CSV exports for data migration no later than Week 5
Client stakeholders will commit 4–6 hours per week during Discovery and UAT phases
data.change_control: Any requests falling outside Section 2.1 will be evaluated via a formal Change Request (CR) detailing schedule and cost impacts.
